notes.scope: Complete paragraph-level Chinese-English bilingual reader covering main paper and all appendices (Appendices A-F).
notes.source_coverage: All 14 PDF pages were extracted. Main text occupies pages 1-7; Appendix A-F occupy pages 8-13; References occupy pages 13-14.
notes.paragraph_policy: Source prose is organized into paired English (Para. X:) and Chinese (Para. X[CN]:) blockquotes with colored labels.
notes.reference_policy: All 32 references are preserved in searchable English bibliographic form.
notes.asset_policy: Figures 1-4, Figures S1-S3, Tables 1-5, and Tables S1-S4 are linked locally from assets/. Substantive tables are fully transcribed into clean Markdown tables.

blocks.summary: Motivation of self-grounded WAM, clean-action conditioning, future self-mask supervision, and core empirical findings.
Policy-facing world model requirements, FastWAM background and limitations, modality-specialized MoT, and contributions list.
World-Action Models (UVA, UWM, FastWAM, GigaWorld-Policy, tau0-WM) and Structured Visual/Robot Body Modeling.
Self-grounded WAM formulation, multi-view observations, action chunks, and optimal policy/world model definitions; equations 1-5.
MoT architecture, parameter interpolation, asymmetric information flow, directed attention pattern, and robot mask prediction; equation 6.
Joint flow-matching training objective, RGB and self-mask mixture, and fast action-only inference deployment; equation 7.
WAN2.2-5B initialization, composite resolution, RoboTwin 2.0 multi-task setup, and hardware specifications.
50-task RoboTwin 2.0 evaluation and real-robot dual-arm pick-and-place manipulation experiments.
275-trajectory future-video fidelity evaluation (LPIPS, PSNR, FVD-I3D) and directional action perturbation studies.
Component ablation on action conditioning and self-mask supervision, plus NVIDIA H200 latency/memory benchmarks.
Summary of contributions and grant acknowledgements.

50 RoboTwin 2.0 task-level success rates table (Table S4) and future-video fidelity protocols.

blocks.summary: WorldArena Action Following and Raw Consistency metrics, directional perturbations, and continuous action interpolation; equations S1-S5.

blocks.section: Appendix D Consistency of the Clean and Noisy Action Paths
blocks.summary: Layerwise NRMSE and cosine distance evaluation of clean vs noisy action representations at zero perturbation.

blocks.section: Appendix E Real Robot Experimental Details
blocks.summary: AgileX ALOHA platform, 30 Hz joint-position control, RobotSeg offline whole-robot segmentation, and task execution rules.

blocks.summary: Discussion of lack of explicit contact, force, and occlusion modeling.
